name: Pitrillistian
description: The Pitrillistians were a sentient species of large, imposing beings hailing from the planet Pitrillistia, in the Mieru'kar sector. They were a peaceful people who communicated through a series of musical buzzes. The Pitrillistians were marked by the fact that they had two completely different fine manipulators—the left was more insectoid, while the right was more humanoid.

data.name: Pitrillistian
data.distinctions: One humanoid hand, one insectoid hand
